places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jaundiced Sheriff July and deputy Roscoe sit by the one-cell jail; widowed Peach presses July to pursue Jake Spoon for killing Ben, the mayor.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Roscoe and Joe fish for catfish there; brawling rivermen are the sheriff's biggest headache.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: July caught jaundice there at a trial; Elmira was once married there to Dee Boot.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Peach warns the killer will slip off there if July delays.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: July expects to find Jake around there among friends; Roscoe notes those friends are famous Texas Rangers.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Roscoe frets about July tangling with Jake's Texas Ranger friends.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Elmira comes from there, so Fort Smith knows little of her past.

groups.label: Fort Smith lawmen
groups.hint: July heading home from the jail; Roscoe stays on the jail porch

groups.label: Peach
groups.hint: heading home with her dead rooster
